rulings.a: Items 2, 23, 42/50, 46 (when can I visit? / mosque itself when? / blog paragraphs without times / 正午 visit during prayer): NOT translation defects. The absence of any mosque visiting time, affirmative or negative, is Eyad's decision of 2026-10-02 and the zh text mirrors the corrected ar/en exactly. Raised to Eyad as a known consequence: Chinese readers are left asking whether they can enter at prayer time (sharpest at the 48-hours itinerary slot 正午：贾瓦塔清真寺, which falls on Dhuhr, and on Fridays on Jumu'ah); any guidance must come from the source in ar/en first.
rulings.b: Item 1 (尊重场所的神圣 → …的神圣性 / 尊重宗教场所): no edit in this batch; queued as a later polish item. Reasons: (1) the wording predates the batch and was approved by the judge on 2026-09-27; the brief mandates the minimal edit that removes time references only; (2) 尊重/维护…的神圣 with 神圣 as a noun is attested usage, so this is a nativeness deduction (-3), not an error; (3) a judge edit here would be unseen by the blind reader and would touch 14 positions plus the C29 constant. Recommended later item: 尊重场所的神圣 → 尊重场所的神圣性 (one character, all 12 rows + both blog clauses byte-identical, C29 VISIT_VALUE/BLOG_CLAUSE zh updated in the same commit, blind-reader round required).
rulings.c: Item 37 (Uqair: card 开放参观 vs body 部分区域可能暂不开放): source-level — en carries the same restoration sentence ("some parts may be closed"). Raise to Eyad; no zh change.
